title: internal/runstate maintenance fixture's control leg reads the host's git, red at base on this host
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo (internal/runstate/maintenance_test.go:38) fails at the base commit 221fc39736ce on this host: its CONTROL leg asserts that a plain `git fetch` starts git automatic maintenance in the armed repository, which depends on the host git's version and config, and here it does not fire — so the fixture proves nothing and `make test` is red at base. Same class as w33 (a test measuring its host, not the tree): the control leg should construct the maintenance trigger deterministically (or arm the repository so the fetch must start it regardless of host git defaults) rather than inherit the host's behaviour.
